tool.name: LEMUR
tool.command: export OMP_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && Rscript '$__tool_directory__/lemur.R' --input_rds '$sce' --meta_table '$meta_table' --cell_id_column '$cell_id_column' --condition_column '$condition_column' #if str($covariate_columns).strip() not in ('', 'None'): --covariate_columns '$covariate_columns' #end if --contrast_condition '$contrast_condition' --reference_condition '$reference_condition' --n_embedding '$n_embedding' --test_fraction '$test_fraction' --linear_coefficient_estimator '$linear_coefficient_estimator' --use_assay '$use_assay' --consider '$consider' --group_by_columns '$group_by_columns' --test_method '$test_method' --n_threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --output_umap 'umap_out' --output_volcano 'volcano_out' --output_de 'de_results.tsv' #if str($sel_gene).strip(): --sel_gene '$sel_gene' --output_gene_umap 'gene_umap_out' --output_gene_hist 'gene_hist_out' #end if --use_harmony '$use_harmony' --plot_format '$plot_format' --plot_width '$plot_width' --plot_height '$plot_height' --run_tumor_analysis '$tumor_analysis_cond.run_tumor_analysis' #if str($tumor_analysis_cond.run_tumor_analysis) == 'yes': --output_chr_scatter 'chr_scatter_out' --output_tumor_umap 'tumor_umap_out' --output_tumor_neigh 'tumor_neigh.tsv' --tumor_annotation_column '$tumor_analysis_cond.tumor_annotation_column' --chrom1_name '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom1_name' --chrom2_name '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom2_name' --chrom1_thresh '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom1_thresh' --chrom2_thresh '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom2_thresh' #end if

param.name: meta_table
param.label: Sample metadata table (TSV)
param.help: Tabular file with one row per sample/cell. Must contain columns for condition and optionally for batch or covariates.

param.name: cell_id_column
param.label: Cell ID column
param.help: Column in metadata that contains the cell IDs matching colnames of SCE

param.name: condition_column
param.label: Condition column
param.help: Any metadata column with two or more levels (e.g. treatment, batch, timepoint, genotype), not only a treatment variable. The comparison is built from the two values you enter in 'Condition for contrast' and 'Reference condition' below.

param.name: covariate_columns
param.label: Covariate columns (optional)
param.help: Optional covariate variables to add to the LEMUR design formula, in addition to the condition (e.g. batch, sex, age). These affect the model fit only; the replication unit used for the differential expression test is set separately below.

param.name: group_by_columns
param.label: Group-by column(s) for differential expression
param.help: Metadata column(s) defining the replication unit that find_de_neighborhoods uses to form pseudobulk samples (e.g. patient or sample ID). Required. The condition and any design covariates are added automatically, so select only the replication variable(s) here.

param.name: test_fraction
param.label: The fraction of cells that are split off before the model fit to keep an independent set of test observations

param.name: linear_coefficient_estimator
param.label: Linear coefficient estimator
param.help: Estimator used to center the conditions in the linear model fit.

param.name: use_assay
param.label: Assay to use for model fitting
param.help: Name of the SCE assay used for LEMUR model fitting (also used as the continuous assay by the 'limma' DE method). The 'glmGamPoi' and 'edgeR' DE methods instead read the raw 'counts' assay, so a counts assay is required unless the DE test method is set to 'limma'.

param.name: consider
param.label: Model parts considered for the DE test
param.help: Which part of the model is considered for the differential expression test. Note: 'linear' can fail in find_de_neighborhoods with the default direction-selection setting, because the DE assay then has no embedding-dependent variation, making the correlation against random directions undefined.

param.name: test_method
param.label: Pseudobulk DE test method
param.help: Statistical method for the pseudobulk differential expression test in find_de_neighborhoods. 'glmGamPoi' and 'edgeR' operate on the raw 'counts' assay; 'limma' operates on the continuous assay (see 'Assay to use for model fitting'). 'none' skips this test entirely: the exported DE table then has no lfc/pval/adj_pval columns, and the volcano plot is not produced.

param.name: use_harmony
param.label: Apply Harmony alignment?
param.help: Enforces additional alignment of cell clusters beyond the direct differential embedding.

param.name: sel_gene
param.label: Gene ID for gene-specific plots (optional)
param.help: Must match a gene ID in the rownames of the SCE object.

param.name: run_tumor_analysis
param.label: Run tumor-specific classification (chromosome-based)
param.help: Optional: classifies cells as tumor/non-tumor based on chromosome gain/loss (as in the glioblastoma example). Not applicable to all datasets — enable only if relevant to your data.

param.name: tumor_annotation_column
param.label: Gene annotation column (in rowData)
param.help: Name of the gene-level (rowData) annotation column that assigns each gene to a chromosome, used to compute per-chromosome expression for tumor classification. Default is 'chromosome'. Override if your SCE uses a different rowData column name.

param.name: chrom1_thresh
param.label: Minimum expression threshold for the gained chromosome
param.help: Minimum mean expression of the gained chromosome (above) required to classify a cell as tumor.

param.name: chrom2_thresh
param.label: Maximum expression threshold for the lost chromosome
param.help: Maximum mean expression of the lost chromosome (above) required to classify a cell as tumor.

tool.help:
LEMUR identifies transcriptional differences across conditions in latent space using single-cell RNA-seq data. This tool wraps the core LEMUR workflow (latent embedding multivariate regression) and can be applied to single-cell data from any tissue or cell type — it is not limited to any specific disease or dataset.
**Inputs:** - A `SingleCellExperiment` object in RDS format. - A metadata table, with column selectors for the condition and, optionally, one or more covariate columns; the design formula is built as `~ covariates + condition`, where "condition" is whichever column you select and the comparison is between two of its levels (given in the contrast and reference fields). - Parameters for dimensionality and model training. - Optionally, a gene ID for extra gene-specific plots. - Apply Harmony alignment: If selected, the latent space is aligned using Harmony before differential expression analysis. - Selectable output format for all plots: PDF, PNG, or JPG.
**Why use `SingleCellExperiment` (SCE)?** LEMUR uses the `SingleCellExperiment` (SCE) format because it is the standard Bioconductor structure for single-cell data in R. Unlike Seurat or AnnData, SCE is lightweight, interoperable, and not tied to a specific framework. It cleanly separates assays (e.g., expression values), cell metadata (`colData`), feature metadata (`rowData`), and reduced dimensions (`reducedDims`).
For LEMUR to work correctly, the SCE object **must include**: - **`counts()`**: matrix of raw (non-normalized) integer counts, required for the pseudobulk differential expression test in `find_de_neighborhoods()` when the DE test method is `glmGamPoi` (the default) or `edgeR`. The `limma` method instead uses the continuous assay (see "Assay to use for model fitting"), so counts are not needed when `limma` is selected. - **`logcounts()`**: matrix of log-normalized gene expression, used for model fitting and visualization. - **`colData`**: must contain the variables referenced in the `design` formula (e.g., `patient_id`, `condition`).
You can easily convert Seurat objects using `as.SingleCellExperiment()` in R. Within Galaxy, you can convert between single-cell formats (e.g. Seurat or AnnData) and `SingleCellExperiment` using the **sceasy** and **anndata2ri** tools.
**Outputs:** - UMAP plot - Volcano plot - Table of differentially expressed neighborhoods. Note: `find_de_neighborhoods()` returns each neighborhood's member cell IDs as a nested list-column, which cannot be represented in a flat TSV, so that column is dropped from the exported table. - Gene UMAP + histogram plots if a gene ID is given
**Optional tumor-specific classification:** Enabling "Run tumor-specific classification" performs a chromosome gain/loss-based tumor/non-tumor cell classification, using two configurable chromosome-arm markers (default: chromosome 7 gain / chromosome 10 loss, as used in the glioblastoma example below). This approach can be applied to other tumor types with known chromosome-level copy number alterations by adjusting the chromosome names and thresholds to match your data — it is disabled by default since it's only relevant if your dataset includes this kind of copy-number-based tumor signal. When enabled, it adds three outputs: a chromosome expression scatter plot, a tumor/non-tumor UMAP plot, and a table of differentially expressed neighborhoods restricted to the classified tumor cells.
**More information:** For details on the LEMUR method, see the official LEMUR repository: https://github.com/const-ae/lemur
